$comment: Hand-override registry for token logos. Keys are 'chain:address' (address lowercased) or 'symbol:SYMBOL' for chain-agnostic overrides. Values are public URLs or workspace-relative paths under /public. resolveTokenLogo() checks this map first, then cascades DexScreener, TrustWallet, CoinGecko. Use this to ship $WAIFU's logo the moment it mints, or to override an ugly auto-resolved icon. To enable an override, add the key here and ensure the file exists under apps/frontend/public.
